evidenceMatrix.claim: The system supports two primary interactive stream modes: legacy Gemini stream and the new AgentProtocol-backed stream.
LegacyAgentSession adapts the existing Gemini client and scheduler loop to the AgentProtocol interface using an event translator.
AgentRegistry discovers and loads built-in, user-level, project-level, and extension-provided agents.
LocalSubagentInvocation executes local agents using LocalAgentExecutor and bridges their streaming activity to the tool's output.
RemoteAgentInvocation bypasses the local executor loop and directly invokes remote A2A agents via A2AClientManager.
Agent scheduling uses a subagent-specific context, including isolated ToolRegistry and PromptRegistry instances.
